purpose: 五种场景风格预览，待用户选定；未替换游戏背景

options.name: 电影写实
options.description: 自然光、真实材质与克制反光，城市生活感最强。
options.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: background art direction option for a Chinese visual novel titled 毕节，雨停之前.
Input image: the provided local image bg-street.png is the SCENE/COMPOSITION REFERENCE and edit target.
Primary request: reinterpret this EXACT rainy street composition in the specified visual medium. This is a background-only art-style test, not a new environment.
Keep invariant: the eye-level camera, gently rising curved street, left near awning and warm storefront with umbrellas, right noodle-shop window and small exterior stairs, modest concrete shop-houses, overhead wires, hillside housing and mountain silhouettes, wet pavement and rainy evening. Contemporary fictional neighborhood in Bijie, Guizhou, China. Credible everyday Chinese urban environment. Keep approximate object positions and perspective so options are comparable.
Landscape 16:9. Foreground lower 25% has quiet detail for dialogue, center-right has room for a character sprite. Cool gray-blue air and warm practical shop lights, with medium-specific restrained variation. No humans or characters, no vehicles added, no real brands, no watermark, no captions or typography, no UI. Do not add Japanese architecture, lanterns or lettering, cyberpunk cityscape, fantasy architecture, extreme poverty or ruin. Preserve believable scale and lived-in human warmth.
Style/medium for this option: Naturalistic cinematic environment photography, sophisticated location still from a contemporary Chinese slice-of-life film. Physical wet asphalt, unpolished painted concrete, delicate practical light, broad natural dynamic range, restrained depth of field. Tactile and plausible rather than glossy game render. No visible outlines, no painterly brushstrokes, no exaggerated bloom. Slight neutral-gray shadows rather than aggressive teal grading; amber lighting stays grounded. It must be convincingly photographic and clearly different from animation or watercolor.
